name: Seasons (Official)
author: Golf Tycoon
description: The shipped seasons: four theme-aware seasons over the calendar year. Golfer demand, upkeep, green-fee tolerance, tournament prestige and the weather all follow the season, eight seasonal events (Spring Opening Week, the Fall Classic...) punctuate the year, and the woodland turns with them - the spring, fall and winter tree art ships in this mod's own tree_art folder. Turn the feature on per company at Start New Game; disable this mod to remove seasons from the game entirely.
